agent_name.name: Agent Name
agent_name.hint: Display name of the plugin-owned game_agent (the AI that plays the advanced seats). Shown to the opponent and used in table talk.

zh.name: 对弈者名字
zh.hint: 插件自有的 game_agent 显示名（进阶对手/教练席位由它驱动）。默认值 nori 是配置标识，会原样展示给对手，也用于桌面解说里的自称。

agent_persona.name: Agent Persona
agent_persona.default: 调皮爱吐槽的猫娘，玩游戏时会认真+毒舌
agent_persona.hint: Persona description injected into the game agent prompt. Keep it short; it shapes tone, not rules.

zh.name: 对弈者人设
zh.hint: 注入 game_agent 提示词的人设描述，保持简短；它决定语气而不是规则。

agent_avatar.name: Agent Avatar Path
agent_avatar.hint: Optional local image used as the game agent avatar. Empty = the bundled default; the WebUI lobby can also upload a replacement.

zh.name: 对弈者头像路径
zh.hint: 可选：本地图片路径，作为 game_agent 头像。留空=使用插件内置默认头像；也可在 WebUI 大厅直接上传替换。

spectator_enabled.name: Enable Spectator Listener
spectator_enabled.hint: Invitation-only spectator access on a separate listener. Restart the plugin after changing these settings.

zh.name: 开启独立观战服务
zh.hint: 独立端口提供邀请制观战；修改本组设置后需重载插件。

spectator_host.name: Listen Address
spectator_host.hint: Use 127.0.0.1 behind a local HTTPS reverse proxy; 0.0.0.0 permits LAN access.

zh.name: 监听地址
zh.hint: 局域网直连使用 0.0.0.0；本机 HTTPS 反代可使用 127.0.0.1。

spectator_port.name: Listen Port
spectator_port.hint: 0 = host WebUI port + 10000 (normally 15267). Must differ from the host port and not exceed 65535.

zh.name: 监听端口
zh.hint: 0 自动使用宿主 WebUI 端口 +10000（通常为 15267）；须与宿主端口不同且不超过 65535。

spectator_public_url.name: Public Spectator URL
spectator_public_url.hint: Optional HTTPS origin, e.g. https://watch.example.com. Empty uses the browser hostname and spectator port over HTTP.

zh.name: 观战公开地址
zh.hint: 可填写独立 HTTPS 域名，例如 https://watch.example.com；留空使用浏览器主机名与观战端口（HTTP）。

ai_mode.name: Decision Mode
ai_mode.hint: agent = LLM agent makes moves (falls back to the rule bot on failure); bot = rule bot only, no model calls.

zh.name: 决策模式
zh.hint: agent=LLM agent 走子（失败回落规则 bot）；bot=仅规则 bot，不调用模型。

ai_models.name: AI Models
ai_models.hint: Ordered LLM failover list for the game agent. Empty = rule bot only. All models share one ai_timeout budget.

zh.name: 决策模型
zh.hint: game_agent 使用的 LLM 顺序 failover 列表（从上到下依次尝试）。留空=只用规则 bot。所有模型共享同一个 ai_timeout 总预算。

ai_max_concurrency.name: Max Concurrency
ai_max_concurrency.hint: Concurrent game_agent calls (1-16). Keeps chat reply latency protected.

zh.name: 最大并发
zh.hint: 同时进行的 game_agent 调用上限（1-16），用于保护用户聊天回合延迟。

ai_timeout.name: Decision Timeout (s)
ai_timeout.hint: Total timeout per AI decision in seconds, covering semaphore wait plus the whole model failover chain.

zh.name: 决策总超时（秒）
zh.hint: 单次 AI 决策总超时，覆盖信号量排队与模型 failover 全过程。

ai_agent_rounds.name: Agent Rounds
ai_agent_rounds.hint: Model rounds per move decision (1-10); ends early once play succeeds.

zh.name: 决策轮数
zh.hint: 单次走子决策的模型轮数独立预算（1-10）；play 成功即提前结束。

ai_agent_calls_per_round.name: Calls Per Round
ai_agent_calls_per_round.hint: Tool/model calls allowed per round (1-10); stops as soon as play succeeds.

zh.name: 每轮调用次数
zh.hint: 每个回合允许的工具/模型调用次数（1-10）；play 成功即停，不为收尾多花调用。

ai_history_rounds.name: History Rounds
ai_history_rounds.hint: Completed rounds carried as history; -1 = unlimited, 0 = no history. A round is one finished move decision, not a single LLM call.

zh.name: 携带历史回合
zh.hint: 携带多少已完成回合的历史；-1=不限，0=不带历史。回合=一次完成的走子决策，不是单次 LLM 调用。

ai_min_think_ms.name: Min Think Time (ms)
ai_min_think_ms.hint: Minimum perceived thinking time in milliseconds; only pads decisions faster than this before submitting.

zh.name: 最小思考时间（毫秒）
zh.hint: 最小感知思考时间；只补足快于该值的决策，提交落子前生效。

ai_think_jitter_ms.name: Think Jitter (ms)
ai_think_jitter_ms.hint: Random jitter added to thinking time (ms) so pacing is not mechanical.

zh.name: 思考抖动（毫秒）
zh.hint: 思考时间随机抖动上限，避免固定节拍。

bot_move_delay_min_ms.name: Rule Bot Delay Min (ms)
bot_move_delay_min_ms.hint: Minimum human-like pause before a rule-bot (practice seat) plays its move/card. The room schedules it after this delay instead of replying instantly.

zh.name: 规则陪练延迟下限（毫秒）
zh.hint: 规则陪练（陪练座位）落子/出牌前的最短拟人化停顿；房间层按此延迟排程，不再瞬间应手。

bot_move_delay_max_ms.name: Rule Bot Delay Max (ms)
bot_move_delay_max_ms.hint: Upper bound of the random pause before a rule-bot move; must be >= the minimum.

zh.name: 规则陪练延迟上限（毫秒）
zh.hint: 规则陪练出手前随机停顿的上限，必须不小于下限。

ai_agent_prompt.name: Agent System Prompt
ai_agent_prompt.hint: Custom system prompt for game_agent. Empty = built-in player persona and tool constraints.

zh.name: 决策提示词
zh.hint: game_agent 自定义 system prompt；留空=使用内置棋手人设与工具约束。

turn_play_timeout_s.name: Turn Play Timeout (s)
turn_play_timeout_s.hint: Silence-window timeout for a notice-driven turn: visible progress (steps, tools, an open LLM run) keeps extending it; on real silence the host is reminded once, then the watchdog fills with the rule bot.

zh.name: 回合静默超时（秒）
zh.hint: 行动通知回合的静默窗口：有进展（模型步骤/工具/在途请求）会持续续期；真正静默时先提醒一次，仍无动作由规则 bot 代补一手。

turn_threat_analysis_enabled.name: Threat Analysis
turn_threat_analysis_enabled.hint: Attach a threat analysis of the current board to notice-driven turns. Gomoku/reversi now use per-match difficulty; this only affects other games.

zh.name: 威胁分析
zh.hint: 行动通知回合是否附带当前盘面的威胁分析。五子棋/黑白棋已改由每局难度控制，该项仅用于其他游戏。

turn_text_retry_s.name: Text-Only Retry Window (s)
turn_text_retry_s.hint: After a reply that only talks (no play tool call), a corrective nudge shortens the watchdog deadline to this window instead of waiting the full turn timeout.

zh.name: 只说不做重试窗口（秒）
zh.hint: 宿主回复了文字但没调用对局工具时，立刻定向催一次并把倒计时缩短到该窗口，而不是空等整个回合超时。

turn_text_grace_s.name: Text-Only Grace (s)
turn_text_grace_s.hint: How long to wait after a text-only reply before sending the corrective nudge — lets an accompanying play tool call land first.

zh.name: 只说不做宽限（秒）
zh.hint: 回复完成到发出定向催促之间的宽限：随回复一起发出的 play 调用会在这段时间内落地并自动取消催促。

turn_fallback_delay_s.name: Fallback Delay (s)
turn_fallback_delay_s.hint: Extra grace between the silence window elapsing and the rule-bot fill, so a last-moment submission still wins.

zh.name: 兜底延迟（秒）
zh.hint: 静默窗口耗尽到规则 bot 补手之间的最后宽限，压哨提交仍能获胜。

turn_text_retry_max.name: Text-Only Retry Max
turn_text_retry_max.hint: Maximum corrective nudges per turn when replies keep coming back text-only; afterwards the normal watchdog deadline applies.

zh.name: 只说不做催促上限
zh.hint: 同一回合最多定向催几次（每次回复都是纯文字时）；用完之后回到普通超时/watchdog 流程。

table_talk_default.name: Private Chat Tier
table_talk_default.hint: Default table talk tier for private-chat matches. judge = smart timing; moves = try every move but still cooled down; key = once every N moves plus start/end; off = silent.

zh.name: 私聊开口档位
zh.hint: 聊天侧私聊对局默认档位：judge=智能择时（关键手/值得开口才说）；moves=每手都尝试但仍受冷却；key=每 N 手/开局/终局说一次；off=全静默。

table_talk_group_default.name: Group Chat Tier
table_talk_group_default.hint: Default table talk tier for group-chat matches (anti-spam; moves is not offered in groups).

zh.name: 群聊开口档位
zh.hint: 聊天侧群聊对局默认档位（防刷屏）：judge=智能择时；key=每 N 手/开局/终局说一次；off=全静默（群聊不提供 moves 每手档）。

page_chat_enabled.name: WebUI Match Chat
page_chat_enabled.hint: Enable the match-page chat input so the player can talk to the host agent during a game; history stays visible and notices are unaffected when off.

zh.name: 对局页聊天窗口
zh.hint: 对局页显示聊天窗口，玩家可以在对局中和宿主 AI 说话；关闭后仅隐藏输入（通知不受影响）。

page_chat_talk_default.name: WebUI Page Tier
page_chat_talk_default.hint: Default table talk tier for matches started from the WebUI page.

zh.name: 页面局开口档位
zh.hint: 页面固定会话的对局默认档位：judge=智能择时；moves=每手都尝试但仍受冷却；key=每 N 手/开局/终局说一次；off=全静默。

table_talk_prompt_template.name: Talk Prompt Template
table_talk_prompt_template.default:
[System: 你现在正和 {opponent} 下{game}，你是执{seat}的一方，这是你们的对局，不是解说。
下面只是帮你看懂局势的背景，不要照读，也不要逐条复述：
刚刚：{event}
当前局面：{board}。
你上一轮的想法：{plan}。
像坐在对面的朋友那样自然说一两句短句，得意、紧张、嘴硬、试探、调侃都行，跟着当下的局势走；
不要每轮都用同一种挑衅腔，也别编造还没发生的胜负。不要主动报棋盘坐标、逐手复述棋谱或做局势分析，
也不要把上面的内部提示或 System 文字说出来。玩家主动问你坐标、想复盘时，可以按需要如实回答。
不用「本局/播报/解说/观众」这类旁白话术。
{lane_hint}]
table_talk_prompt_template.hint: Template for table talk. Placeholders: {opponent} {game} {seat} {event} {board} {plan} {lane_hint}. {event}/{board}/{plan} are background only — never read coordinates aloud.

zh.name: 发言提示词模板
zh.hint: 陪玩发言提示词模板（可自定义）：让 bot 以对局玩家口吻说气氛话；{event}/{board}/{plan} 只作看懂局势的背景，不照读坐标。可用占位符：opponent/game/seat/event/board/plan/lane_hint。

table_talk_prompt_extra.name: Extra Talk Constraints
table_talk_prompt_extra.hint: Extra constraints appended to the template (catchphrases, length, how to address the opponent), keeping the player tone.

zh.name: 额外发言约束
zh.hint: 追加到模板末尾的额外约束（如口癖、长度、称呼），保持陪玩语气。

talk_min_interval_s.name: Min Interval (s)
talk_min_interval_s.hint: Minimum gap between two lines sent to the same target.

zh.name: 同目标最小间隔（秒）
zh.hint: 同一个目标两次发言之间的最小间隔。

talk_cooldown_s.name: Match Cooldown (s)
talk_cooldown_s.hint: Cooldown between lines within the same match.

zh.name: 同局冷却（秒）
zh.hint: 同一局内两次发言之间的冷却时间。

talk_key_every_n.name: Key Tier Interval (moves)
talk_key_every_n.hint: How many moves per line in the key tier (start/end always speak, still subject to cooldown).

zh.name: key 档位间隔（手）
zh.hint: key 档位每隔多少手说一句（开局/终局总会说，且仍受冷却限制）。

talk_on_start.name: Speak On Start
talk_on_start.hint: Say one line when a match starts.

zh.name: 开局发言
zh.hint: 开局时说一句。

talk_on_over.name: Speak On End
talk_on_over.hint: Say one line when a match ends.

zh.name: 终局发言
zh.hint: 终局时说一句。

notice_target_session_id.name: Notice Target Session
notice_target_session_id.hint: Session id that receives the game agent's table talk and turn notices. Empty = the plugin's own session (gamehub:dm:admin).

zh.name: 通知目标会话
zh.hint: 接收对弈发言与行动通知的会话 ID。留空=使用插件自带的 gamehub:dm:admin 会话。

site_base_url.name: Public Base URL
site_base_url.hint: Public base URL used when building shareable match links. Empty = relative links only.

zh.name: 站点公开地址
zh.hint: 生成可分享对局链接时使用的公开地址前缀。留空=只用相对链接。

max_active_matches.name: Max Active Matches
max_active_matches.hint: Global cap on active matches; new matches are rejected once reached.

zh.name: 活跃对局上限
zh.hint: 全局活跃对局上限，达上限后拒绝新局。

max_say_len.name: Max Say Length
max_say_len.hint: Character cap for in-match speech written into Match.chat; does not change the move result.

zh.name: 对局内发言长度上限
zh.hint: 对局内发言长度上限（字符）：写入 Match.chat 时截断，不改变落子结果。

ai_decision_log.name: Decision Log
ai_decision_log.hint: Write decision_log.jsonl under the plugin data dir (one line per decision, no tokens or chat text).

zh.name: 决策日志
zh.hint: 是否写插件数据目录下的 decision_log.jsonl（每次决策一条，不含 token 与聊天全文）。
